_comment: One value, one mapped field, one expected verdict. Used twice: the offline
suite asserts logsearch.conflicts agrees with this table, and the live-marked
test is written to replay every row against the CI service container, which
A cluster cannot be asked for a verdict directly, so the live test reads it
from behaviour. ok and coerced both index cleanly under the strict mapping.
malformed is rejected by the strict mapping and accepted by the lenient one
with the field named in _ignored. shape is rejected by both, because
ignore_malformed does not cover an object sent to a scalar field.
ok and coerced are not distinguished there, only here.
